mapper.select: SELECT proj_id AS "id",proj_nm AS "name",cust_clnt_id AS "customerId",ctrt_type_cd AS "contractType",proj_stat_cd AS "status", ctrt_bgn_dt AS "startDate",ctrt_end_dt AS "endDate",work_plc_addr AS "workplace",feature_cn AS "feature", est_amt::text AS "estimateAmount",orgnl_ctrt_amt::text AS "originalContractAmount",ctrt_amt::text AS "contractAmount", bdgt_amt::text AS "budgetAmount",team_exps_amt::text AS "teamExpenseAmount",proj_exps_amt::text AS "projectExpenseAmount", bdgt_manual_yn AS "budgetManual",lose_dt AS "lossDate",lose_rsn_cd AS "lossReason",lose_memo AS "lossMemo",opp_id AS "opportunityId" FROM tb_pj_proj WHERE proj_id=#{id}

SELECT p.proj_id AS "id",p.proj_nm AS "name",p.ctrt_type_cd AS "contractType",p.ctrt_bgn_dt AS "startDate",p.ctrt_end_dt AS "endDate", p.ctrt_amt::text AS "contractAmount",p.proj_stat_cd AS "status",c.clnt_nm AS "customerName", (SELECT count(DISTINCT a.dev_id) FROM tb_pj_asgn a WHERE a.proj_id=p.proj_id AND a.asgn_stat_cd='ACT' AND a.input_bgn_dt <= #{today} AND a.input_end_dt >= #{today}) AS "personCount", (SELECT b.part_nm FROM tb_pj_proj_part r LEFT JOIN tb_bs_part b ON b.part_id=r.part_id WHERE r.proj_id=p.proj_id AND r.aply_bgn_ym <= #{month} ORDER BY r.aply_bgn_ym DESC LIMIT 1) AS "partName",NULL AS "distribution" FROM tb_pj_proj p LEFT JOIN tb_bs_clnt c ON c.clnt_id=p.cust_clnt_id WHERE p.proj_stat_cd IN ('ING','PRE') AND p.ctrt_end_dt >= #{today} AND (strpos(p.proj_nm,#{q}) > 0 OR strpos(p.proj_id,#{q}) > 0 OR strpos(c.clnt_nm,#{q}) > 0) ORDER BY p.proj_nm,p.proj_id
SELECT code_val FROM tb_sy_code WHERE code_grp_id='ALWNC' AND code=#{code} AND use_yn='Y' AND del_yn='N'
SELECT code_nm FROM tb_sy_code WHERE code_grp_id='LOSE_RSN' AND code=#{code} AND use_yn='Y' AND del_yn='N'

SELECT a.asgn_id AS "assignmentId",a.dev_id AS "developerId",d.mng_no AS "managementNo",d.dev_nm AS "name",a.job_cd AS "jobCode", COALESCE(c.code_nm,a.job_cd) AS "jobName",a.input_bgn_dt AS "startDate",a.input_end_dt AS "endDate", a.ctrt_mm::text AS "contractMm",COALESCE((SELECT sum(m.mon_mm) FROM tb_pj_asgn_mon m WHERE m.asgn_id=a.asgn_id),0)::numeric(12,2)::text AS "monthlyMmTotal", a.asgn_stat_cd AS "status" FROM tb_pj_asgn a JOIN tb_hr_dev d ON d.dev_id=a.dev_id LEFT JOIN tb_sy_code c ON c.code_grp_id='JOB' AND c.code=a.job_cd WHERE a.proj_id=#{id} ORDER BY a.asgn_id

SELECT asgn_id AS "id",dev_id AS "developerId",input_bgn_dt AS "startDate",input_end_dt AS "endDate",ctrt_mm AS "contractMm",bill_uprc AS "price",asgn_stat_cd AS "status" FROM tb_pj_asgn WHERE proj_id=#{id} ORDER BY asgn_id

SELECT json_build_object( 'assignments',COALESCE((SELECT json_agg(row_to_json(a) ORDER BY a.asgn_id) FROM tb_pj_asgn a WHERE a.proj_id=#{id}),'[]'::json), 'months',COALESCE((SELECT json_agg(row_to_json(m) ORDER BY m.asgn_id,m.input_ym) FROM tb_pj_asgn_mon m JOIN tb_pj_asgn a ON a.asgn_id=m.asgn_id WHERE a.proj_id=#{id}),'[]'::json), 'history',COALESCE((SELECT json_agg(row_to_json(h) ORDER BY h.asgn_id,h.hist_sn) FROM tb_pj_asgn_hist h JOIN tb_pj_asgn a ON a.asgn_id=h.asgn_id WHERE a.proj_id=#{id}),'[]'::json))::text

SELECT hist_sn AS "serial",asgn_chg_type_cd AS "type",aply_dt AS "date",new_ctrt_mm AS "mm",new_uprc AS "price",crct_yn AS "corrected",crct_trgt_sn AS "target" FROM tb_pj_asgn_hist WHERE asgn_id=#{id} ORDER BY aply_dt,hist_sn
SELECT input_ym AS "month",fix_yn AS "fixed" FROM tb_pj_asgn_mon WHERE asgn_id=#{id} ORDER BY input_ym
SELECT COALESCE(max(hist_sn),0) FROM tb_pj_asgn_hist WHERE asgn_id=#{id}
SELECT DISTINCT cost_ym FROM tb_co_mon_cost WHERE proj_id=#{id} AND cost_cls_cd='PRE' AND fix_yn='N' ORDER BY cost_ym
mapper.update: LOCK TABLE tb_cl_close IN SHARE MODE
UPDATE tb_pj_asgn SET asgn_stat_cd='CNCL',input_end_dt=#{date},early_wthdr_yn='Y', mod_user_id=#{actor},mod_dttm=#{now} WHERE asgn_id=#{id} AND proj_id=#{projectId} AND asgn_stat_cd='ACT'
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM tb_pj_asgn_mon WHERE asgn_id=#{id} AND input_ym=#{month} AND fix_yn='N'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_pj_asgn_mon(asgn_id,input_ym,dev_id,proj_id,input_day_cnt,mon_mm,aply_uprc,sales_amt,fix_yn,reg_user_id,reg_dttm) VALUES(#{id},#{month},#{developerId},#{projectId},#{days},#{mm},#{price},0,'N',#{actor},#{now}) ON CONFLICT (asgn_id,input_ym) DO UPDATE SET input_day_cnt=#{days},mon_mm=#{mm},aply_uprc=#{price},sales_amt=0,mod_user_id=#{actor},mod_dttm=#{now} WHERE tb_pj_asgn_mon.fix_yn='N'
mapper.update: UPDATE tb_co_mon_cost SET cost_cls_cd='IDLE',mod_user_id=#{actor},mod_dttm=#{now} WHERE proj_id=#{id} AND cost_cls_cd='PRE' AND fix_yn='N' AND cost_ym=#{month}
